features.name: total_bilirubin
features.label: Total Bilirubin
features.description: Total bilirubin includes both direct and indirect bilirubin; elevated levels indicate liver excretion or hemolysis issues.

features.name: direct_bilirubin
features.label: Direct Bilirubin
features.description: Conjugated bilirubin processed by hepatocytes; sensitive marker for biliary obstruction.

features.name: alkaline_phosphotase
features.label: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
features.description: Enzyme concentrated in liver bile duct cells; higher values indicate cholestatic pathology.

features.name: alamine_aminotransferase
features.label: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT / SGPT)
features.description: Intracellular liver enzyme released during hepatocellular injury and inflammation.

features.name: aspartate_aminotransferase
features.label: Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST / SGOT)
features.description: Mitochondrial and cytosolic enzyme found in liver and heart; high AST/ALT ratio indicates advanced injury.

features.name: total_protiens
features.label: Total Proteins
features.description: Measures total serum albumin and globulin proteins synthesized primarily by the liver.

features.name: albumin
features.label: Albumin
features.description: Major protein produced exclusively by the liver; maintains oncotic pressure and transports substances.

features.name: albumin_and_globulin_ratio
features.label: A/G Ratio
features.description: Ratio of albumin to globulins. Values below 1.0 indicate chronic liver dysfunction or cirrhosis.
